'''Reactor injector modules''' were [[Engine/Legends|engine]] components. If [[Lowickan Firegem]]s were introduced into a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] reactor injector module, it allowed the [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] to be used as a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
